sentences.en: He constantly violated school rules and consequently he was expelled.
sentences.zh: 他 constantly 违反校规，因此被开除。

sentences.en: He was violating school rules and consequently he was expelled.
sentences.zh: 他一直在违反校规，因而被开除。

sentences.en: It rained heavily, and consequently the baseball game was called off.
sentences.zh: 雨下得很大，因此棒球比赛取消了。
